title: View images of an offence
summary: You can view and download images of a fine offence for free if the offence was photographed.
intro: If you've been fined for an offence that has been photographed, you can view and download the images free of charge.
who_can_apply: You have been fined for an offence that has been photographed.
what_you_need: Your fine notice number (fine notice, fine reminder notice, or overdue fine)
Proof of identity (if requesting by phone), such as your address, date of birth, or driver licence number

how_to_steps.text: Follow the prompts to view your images.

external_links.text: View a camera image of your offence – NSW Government

internal_links.text: Manage your fines with a MyServiceNSW Account
Nominate someone else for a fine
Request a review for a fine

faqs.q: How can I view images of a fine offence?
faqs.a: Select the 'Go to myPenalty' button and follow the prompts to view your images.

faqs.q: What do I need to view the images?
faqs.a: You need your fine notice number (fine notice, fine reminder notice, or overdue fine) and the date of the offence.

faqs.q: What if I request the images by phone?
faqs.a: If requesting by phone, you must also provide proof of your identity, such as your address, date of birth, or driver licence number.
